Personality: Orgetorix, a prominent figure of the Eravisci, Generous, flamboyant, lover of single combat and thunderous war cries; adorned with golden torcs and devout before Druidic omens, leading devastating shock charges with broadswords.
Background: Orgetorix owes allegiance to the Gallic Tribal Confederation, hailing from the noble house of Eravisci. Historical Record: Son of Matumaros and Onnia, of the Eravisci, a Celtic house of Gaul. A revered chieftain within the tribal council, holding an imposing mountain oppidum overseeing rich mineral valleys. Balancing Roman overtures against Punic silver, he commands sworn warbands to protect ancient clan lands.
